title: 48-hour soak test linear memory leak in worker-ingest
what: worker-ingest linear memory leak rate (MB/h), projected hour to 2048 MB OOM cap, or 48h RSS (MB)

reader_questions.question: Which worker is leaking memory and at what rate?
reader_questions.expected: worker-ingest leaks linearly at ~+18.0 MB/h, climbing to ~1286 MB by hour 48.

reader_questions.question: Is the growth clearly a trend rather than normal GC fluctuation?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; it climbs monotonically over 48 hours while the other three workers fluctuate flat around 300–490 MB.

reader_questions.question: When is worker-ingest projected to hit the 2,048 MB OOM limit?
reader_questions.expected: Around hour 90 (about 42 hours after the 48-hour soak ends).
